publicHeading: Give visitors a reason to trust you immediately.
shortDescription: Keep important services, promises or credentials visible without distracting from the rest of your page.
longDescription: Show your services, guarantees, credentials or visual options in a clear strip that supports the rest of your page. Start from a real business example, then edit with the same controls you will use inside LeadPages.

heroImage.alt: Café service strip style Trust Bar under the fold

modes.name: Text and Icons
modes.description: A compact row of icons and short labels under your hero — ideal for services, promises and credentials.

modes.name: Image Tiles
modes.description: Full-width image tiles with captions — great when visitors need to recognise options at a glance.

benefits.title: Visible without clutter
benefits.text: Keeps key services or credentials in view while the rest of the page stays focused on your offer.

benefits.title: Works on every device
